# NightAccelerator
A Paper plugin to accelerate the night instead of skipping it completely. The acceleration happens based on the percentage of players that are sleeping. A modern spiritual successor to SmoothSleep.

## Installation
See the [wiki](https://github.com/fabianmakila/nightaccelerator/wiki/installation) for platform specific instructions.

## Placeholder support
NightAccelerator provides external placeholders for both [MiniPlaceholders](https://modrinth.com/plugin/miniplaceholders) and [PlaceholderAPI](https://modrinth.com/plugin/placeholderapi). MiniPlaceholders' placeholders are also supported in NightAccelerators own messages.

You can find the list of available placeholders [here](https://github.com/fabianmakila/NightAccelerator/wiki/Placeholders).
